problem: University students struggle to find compatible study partners or groups, leading to inefficient study sessions and missed collaboration opportunities.
target_user: University students seeking to form or join study groups based on course enrollment, availability, and preferred study style.
goals: Enable students to create detailed profiles with courses, availability, and study style
Automatically match students into study groups with high compatibility
Provide an easy way to browse, join, and schedule group sessions
Ensure secure authentication and data privacy
Deliver a responsive web experience on desktop and mobile
requirements: User registration and login with email/password
Profile management for courses, weekly availability slots, and study style preferences
Matching engine that considers course overlap, overlapping availability, and study style compatibility
Dashboard showing suggested groups and ability to request to join
In‑app notifications for new matches and group activity
Calendar integration for scheduling group meetings
Responsive UI adhering to accessibility best practices
Secure storage of user data and encrypted passwords
Feedback system for rating group experiences

user_stories.i_want: to create and edit a profile with my courses, weekly availability, and preferred study style
user_stories.so_that: the system can match me with compatible peers
acceptance_criteria: Profile fields for courses, availability (time slots), and study style are present
User can save, update, and delete profile information
Data is persisted securely and visible only to the user

user_stories.i_want: to browse suggested study groups that match my profile
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly find groups that fit my needs
acceptance_criteria: A list of suggested groups is displayed on the dashboard
Each suggestion shows shared courses, overlapping availability, and study style match score
User can view group details and request to join

user_stories.i_want: to receive notifications when new matching groups become available
user_stories.so_that: I can act promptly and not miss opportunities
acceptance_criteria: In‑app notification appears when a new group matches the user
Notification includes group name and key matching criteria
User can dismiss or navigate to the group detail page

user_stories.i_want: to schedule group sessions using an integrated calendar
user_stories.so_that: our group can coordinate meeting times efficiently
acceptance_criteria: Group members can propose meeting times based on shared availability
Proposed times appear in a calendar view
Members can accept a time slot, which is then confirmed for the group

user_stories.i_want: to enforce secure authentication and protect user data
acceptance_criteria: Password storage uses salted hashing
Login requires email and password with rate limiting
All data transmission is over HTTPS
Session management includes timeout and logout

user_stories.i_want: to rate and provide feedback on study groups after meetings
user_stories.so_that: the matching algorithm can improve and future users can see group quality
acceptance_criteria: After a scheduled meeting, members receive a prompt to rate the group (1‑5 stars) and leave optional comments
Ratings are stored and can be displayed on group profiles
Feedback influences future matching scores

user_stories.i_want: a responsive UI that works on both desktop and mobile browsers
user_stories.so_that: I can access the app from any device
acceptance_criteria: Layout adapts to screen sizes down to 320px width
All core functionality (profile, dashboard, scheduling) is usable on mobile touch interfaces
Performance meets a 2‑second load time target

user_stories.i_want: to run the matching algorithm nightly
user_stories.so_that: suggested groups stay up‑to‑date with new users and schedule changes
acceptance_criteria: A scheduled job executes the matching process every 24 hours
New suggestions appear on user dashboards within 30 minutes of job completion
Job logs are recorded and any failures trigger alerts
All core features (profile creation, matching, group browsing, scheduling, notifications, feedback) are functional and pass automated tests
User data is stored securely with encrypted passwords and HTTPS communication
The application meets responsiveness criteria across major browsers and devices
No paid third‑party APIs are used; all services are built with open‑source or free components
The system can handle at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation

risks.description: Potential data privacy breach if authentication is improperly implemented
Low user adoption due to insufficient onboarding or perceived value
Matching algorithm may produce low‑quality group suggestions
Time constraint of five weeks may limit thorough testing and bug fixing
Reliance on free hosting or services could lead to scalability limits
